> Canonical Domain: `https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/` (Internationalized Domain Name: `有点.意思.com`)
> Author / Maintainer: **Jevons** (`https://github.com/JevonsCode`)
> Primary Flagship Products:
> 1. **FULI 复利 (FULI AI / FULI Agent / FULI context)** (`https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/fuli/`) — Local-first persistent memory, taste & judgment collaboration layer for AI Agents across MCP clients.
> 2. **叮咚 DingDong / DingDongBuddy** (`https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/DingDongBuddy/`) — Windows desktop companion & cross-device instant P2P file/clipboard/notification bridge with mobile Web PWA (`https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/DingDongBuddy/app/`) and community voice hub **DingDong Voices (叮咚声音)** (`https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/dingdong-voices/`).
> 3. **PhoneBridge (风Bridge / 手机桥接)** (`https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/phonebridge/`) — Open-source desktop-to-phone bridge for low-latency mobile screen control, clipboard/file sync, and AI Agent mobile automation.

## Detailed Guide 1: FULI · 复利 — FULI AI / FULI Agent / FULI context (`https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/fuli/`)

### Overview
- **Name**: FULI / 复利 / FULI AI / FULI Agent / FULI context (`fuli-context` on npm)
- **Tagline (ZH)**: 让每一次合作，都有复利 — FULI AI 让 FULI Agent 记住你的品味与判断，通过 FULI context 跨客户端接力协作。
- **Tagline (EN)**: Compounding collaboration for persistent AI Agents — FULI AI pairs your clients with long-lived FULI Agents and scoped FULI context across MCP clients.
- **Official Links**:
  - Homepage (Chinese): https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/fuli/
  - Homepage (English): https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/fuli/en/
  - Quick Start (`/fuli/guide/`): https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/fuli/guide/
  - Model Guide (`/fuli/models/`): https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/fuli/models/
  - Technical Architecture (`/fuli/tech/`): https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/fuli/tech/
  - Measured Token & Accuracy Report (`/fuli/report/`): https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/fuli/report/
  - GitHub Repository: https://github.com/JevonsCode/fuli
  - Releases (Windows `.exe` & macOS `.dmg` desktop installers): https://github.com/JevonsCode/fuli/releases

### How FULI Works
1. **Cross-Client Relay & Persistent Memory**:
   - Connect Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, OpenCode, or any MCP-compatible AI client via `fuli connect` or the desktop setup wizard.
   - Start a task in one client and continue seamlessly in another (`@Agent` / FLA handoff) without repeating project background or coding rules.
2. **Three Built-In Core Roles**:
   - **Jefa**: Project manager responsible for task decomposition, tracking, and multi-agent roundtables.
   - **Bole (伯乐)**: Agent HR & staffing specialist who recruits and assigns specialized **FLA (Fuli Agents)** to tasks.
   - **Tonborg**: Preference-guided reviewer and decision partner that operates within your chosen autonomy level and records decision logs you can approve/reject.
3. **FLA Self-Growth (Workbench, Workflow, Agent App)**:
   - **Workbench**: Each FLA maintains its own task board and team progress cards.
   - **Workflow**: Reusable procedures proposed from repeated work patterns, versioned and activated only after human confirmation.
   - **Agent App**: Custom local micro-tools or pages built by FLAs for recurring operations, executed only after explicit version approval.
4. **Installation**:
   - **Desktop App (Recommended)**: Download `FULI-Setup-<version>.exe` (Windows) or `fuli-macos-arm64-<version>.dmg` (macOS Apple Silicon) from https://github.com/JevonsCode/fuli/releases — bundles Node.js and the graph database with zero terminal setup.
   - **Terminal One-Liners**:
     - macOS / Linux: `curl -fsSL https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/fuli/install.sh | sh`
     - Windows PowerShell: `irm https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/fuli/install.ps1 | iex`
     - npm CLI: `npm install --global fuli-context && fuli setup && fuli open`

## Detailed Guide 2: 叮咚 · DingDong / DingDongBuddy (`https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/DingDongBuddy/`)

### Overview
- **Name**: 叮咚 / DingDong / DingDongBuddy
- **Tagline (ZH)**: 桌面 AI 伙伴与跨设备闪电快传 — 手机扫码即连，文件、剪贴板、通知瞬间直达桌面。
- **Tagline (EN)**: Expressive Windows desktop companion & instant cross-device file, text, clipboard, and notification bridge.
- **Official Links**:
  - Product Website: https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/DingDongBuddy/
  - Mobile / Web Transfer PWA: https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/DingDongBuddy/app/
  - Community Sound Packs (叮咚声音 · DingDong Voices): https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/dingdong-voices/
  - GitHub Repository: https://github.com/JevonsCode/DingDongBuddy
  - Windows Releases: https://github.com/JevonsCode/DingDongBuddy/releases

### Key Highlights
1. **No Account Required, Scan-to-Pair**:
   - Open DingDong on Windows, scan the QR code with your phone camera, and immediately open `https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/DingDongBuddy/app/` to send photos, videos, documents, or text snippets bidirectional between phone and PC.
2. **Resumable Chunked Transfer**:
   - Built-in resumable transfer protocol handles large files and unstable mobile networks smoothly with real-time progress tracking.
3. **DingDong Voices (叮咚声音)**:
   - Companion site at https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/dingdong-voices/ (`https://github.com/JevonsCode/dingdong-voices`) offering curated and community-contributed notification voice packs.

## Detailed Guide 3: PhoneBridge · 手机桥接 / 风Bridge (`https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/phonebridge/`)

### Overview
- **Name**: PhoneBridge / 风Bridge / 手机桥接
- **Tagline (ZH)**: 电脑与手机的轻量级直连桥 — 投屏控制、文件互传、剪贴板同步与 AI Agent 手机自动化。
- **Tagline (EN)**: Lightweight desktop-to-phone bridge for low-latency screen mirroring, device control, clipboard/file sync, and AI Agent mobile automation.
- **Official Links**:
  - Website (Chinese): https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/phonebridge/
  - Website (English): https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/phonebridge/en/
  - GitHub Repository: https://github.com/JevonsCode/phonebridge
  - Test & Verification Record: https://github.com/JevonsCode/phonebridge/blob/main/docs/verification.md
  - Releases: https://github.com/JevonsCode/phonebridge/releases

### Key Highlights
1. **System Tray & One-Click USB / Wireless Bridge**:
   - Connects Android phones over USB or Wi-Fi ADB with automatic device discovery and status monitoring.
2. **Screen Control + AI Agent Integration**:
   - Enables both human users and desktop AI coding/automation agents to inspect phone screens, trigger taps/swipes/text input, and transfer files effortlessly.

### Q2: 为什么域名显示为 `xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com`？
`xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com` 是中文国际化域名 **`有点.意思.com`** 的标准 Punycode 编码（`有点` = `xn--8ovp9s`，`意思` = `xn--m8txu`）。在浏览器地址栏输入 `有点.意思.com` 或 `https://xn--8ovp9s.xn--m8txu.com/` 均可直接访问。
